description: Compare explicit contracts:{before,after} JSON or bounded YAML 1.2 strings for CI without fetching or retaining source state, or seed/review a public JSON OpenAPI 3.0/3.1 URL against saved observations. Returns directional findings and a conservative CI verdict; YAML is supplied-pair only; no external-ref crawling or live API proof. Release Guardian review exposes stable finding/result IDs, directional rules, affected operations, bounded before/after excerpts, grouped evidence and conservative CI0/1/2. Seed/hash-unchanged observations explicitly report not_compared (CI2). Optional stored-source export_snapshot/baseline_snapshot carries private source context across sessions for the same principal/workflow/environment/scope,30days from observation; not financial authority. One fixed workflow charge; internal steps never create separate customer charges. Explicit API contracts pairs compare immediately without fetching or saved observation state; supplied before/after URNs identify canonical input hashes, not fetched URLs. First URL source use seeds state in this same operation; compatible source_watch_id adopts retained public Register evidence for a genuine first comparison with original scope/time, not ownership. For continuation, later observations use returned owned observation_id. State expires seven days after creation; reads/writes never extend it. Auth: authorized native-USDC x402 v2 on Base, enabled MPP, or an eligible prepaid key plus exact tariff 5 and max_credits. Ordinary unpaid calls return a challenge, not execution. Persist original input, proof and recovery token before submission; exact replay returns retained results without fresh work or another charge. Choose evidence detail before authorization. No free-trial or automatic paid fallback. 0.010 USDC or 4 credits. Limits and scope are authoritative, not a complete audit or compatibility guarantee. The same fixed x402 service price may also be paid in native Circle USDC on Solana Mainnet (solana:5eykt4UsFv8P8NJdTREpY1vzqKqZKvdp), when advertised by the unpaid challenge. Explicitly select one accepted network and pin its mint, merchant, amount and sponsored fee payer before signing. Solana payers need no Base wallet; Standalone native Solana MPP solana/charge is also advertised; its client pays a separately authorized SOL network fee, with no server fee sponsorship. Prepaid MPP funding remains Base-only. Payment network does not change the observed chain: blockchain products still inspect finalized Base. Solana delivery requires finalized matching USDC evidence. Persist the original network, resource, input, proof and private recovery capability; never switch networks or authorize a replacement after uncertainty.

baseline_snapshot.description: Optional private caller-retained Fresh402 snapshot token, at most44,000 characters, as the sole source identity instead of url/source_watch_id/observation_id/contracts. Same verified billing principal, workflow, environment and immutable scope only; compare_to must be previous. Expires30days after source observation. Contains source evidence, not a payment capability or proof of current freshness. Tampered/foreign/expired tokens fail before fetching; never send them to analytics or public repositories.

compare_to.description: Default previous compares with the latest successful workflow observation; baseline compares with its original seed. Seeding is one paid workflow operation and reports no comparison, never a second internal charge.

contracts.description: Explicit CI comparison, exclusive with a stored source/watch. Combined contract text <=48,000 UTF-8 bytes; the complete HTTP/MCP envelope still has its existing 65,536-byte ceiling. References are resolved locally only. Zero source fetches and no saved watch/observation; the original authorized operation remains durably recoverable.

after.description: New complete OpenAPI 3.0/3.1 contract serialized as a JSON or bounded YAML 1.2 string; at most 24,000 characters, same YAML restrictions as before. Direction is before to after; source authenticity and deployed API behavior are not verified.

before.description: Old complete OpenAPI 3.0/3.1 contract serialized as a JSON or bounded YAML 1.2 string; at most 24,000 characters. YAML rejects anchors/aliases, tags, merges, duplicate or complex keys and nonfinite values. No URLs, executed code or remote-reference fetching.

detail.description: Default compact: at most 20 evidence items per section. Expanded allows at most 200 document findings or 100 Base events and retains raw validated logs/getter ABI details within the same fixed work/output ceiling. Counts and omitted-evidence warnings remain explicit.

export_snapshot.description: Optional, default false. Request a caller-retained integrity-protected snapshot of this operation's new source observation, within the existing paid workflow price. Supported only for Website Change Intelligence and stored-source API Compatibility Review. At most32,768 payload bytes/44,000 token characters; oversized evidence reports omitted_size without corrupting the main result. Expires30days after observation; seven-day server state and original financial recovery do not extend. Keep the token private.

observation_id.description: Owned observation_id returned by this same workflow. Reuses its immutable source/scope and saved baseline/latest observations; not a primitive watch_id. Seven-day state retention. Missing, foreign or expired IDs never silently rebaseline.

source_watch_id.description: Adopt the current retained public Register observation as the prior baseline, with its exact immutable URL/scope and original timestamp. No baseline refetch or ownership grant. Exactly one of url, source_watch_id or observation_id; omit scope. Complete compatible normalizer-v2 evidence required; API review additionally requires unfiltered JSON OpenAPI. One paid new observation is compared; save returned owned observation_id for continuation. Missing/incomplete baselines fail explicitly, never silently reseed.

url.description: Public HTTPS source for a new or existing canonical source/scope identity. Exactly one of url, source_watch_id or observation_id. A new URL identity seeds once; the next operation compares.
